info.scr_teacher: 林昱志,盧聖華,蔡雅芝,周哲仲,林碩泰,江俊明,朱延章,林文凱,莊智皓

description.describe_ch: 修習本課程同學在指導教授督導下或參加專業領域實習，運用所學知識進行專題研究，從中學習研究方法、培養實作能力及開拓視野。
description.describe_eh: The course provides students with an opportunity to investigate issues in greater depth or take part in practical training. Students must discuss the project they wish to explore with the advisor. Upon completion of the approved topic, students will accumulate professional experience and broaden their view.
description.pre_subname: OPT2001光學(一)、OPT2002光學(二)、OPT2006應用電子學(一)、OPT2007應用電子學(二)、ENGS2011工程數學(一)、ENGS2013工程數學(二)
description.pre_sub_ename: OPT2001 OPTICS (1)、OPT2002 OPTICS (2)、OPT2006 APPLIED ELECTRONICS(1)、OPT2007 APPLIED ELECTRONICS(2)、ENGS2011 ENGINEERING MATHEMATICS(1)、ENGS2013 ENGINEERING MATHEMATICS(2)

targets.describe_ch: 能設計與建立實驗及分析數據。
